title: Neural quantum states for non-Abelian lattice gauge theories with dynamical fermions
summary: Determining the ground state of non-Abelian lattice gauge theories coupled to dynamical fermions is key to understanding confinement and the phase structure of gauge--matter systems. We present a variational Monte Carlo framework for the ground state of the untruncated fully-continuous SU$(2)$ lattice gauge theory coupled to dynamical staggered fermions on an $L\times L$ square lattice. We work in the magnetic basis with a neural-network representation of the gauge wavefunction.
